_: AD-42. THE FRAMING ONLY. The posters themselves are NOT listed here — every series reads its sheets out of the data file named in `source`, so a title, an alt or a credit exists in exactly one place in this repo. A second copy that merely agrees today is the drift the SEO register was created to stop, and ten poster entries duplicated across two files would be ten chances of it. Adding a series means adding an entry below plus the `posters` array on whatever item actually made them.

masthead.lead: Campaign sheets made to go up on a wall. Shown whole here — the full sheet, its own credit, and the sources it cites, none of it cropped away.

series.head: No Plastic, with GIZ
series.lead: Ten A3 sheets on single-use plastic: what it is, where it ends up, what it does to a body, who is responsible for it, and what to carry instead.

waiting.head: What is not here
waiting.lead: One series is not an archive, and the gaps are worth stating rather than leaving a reader to assume this is everything.

claims.what: This is one series. Swechha has printed campaign material for twenty-seven years and almost none of it has been catalogued, so what is on this page is what has been recovered as a complete set, not what exists.
claims.unlocks: Any other series, complete, with its own credit line.

claims.what: No series here carries a print run or a list of places it went up. The sheets are the artefact; their reach is not recorded.
claims.unlocks: How many were printed and where they went, for any campaign at all.

act.head: Put a set up
act.lead: The sheets were made to be printed. If you have a wall — a school corridor, an office, a shopfront — that is the ask.
